senses.gloss: m. (collect. noun), pl. כַּכֵּי (אכך or חכך, dropped guttural; cmp. אַכָּכָא) molars, in gen. teeth.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 15:19">Targ. Jud. XV, 19</cite> ed. Lag., a. Kimḥi Var. (ed. <cite ref="K00614"><he>כֵּיפָא</he></cite>, h. text <he>מכתש</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 21:35">Targ. Y. Num. XXI, 35</cite> <he>כַּכֵּיה ושיניה</he> his molars and his (front) teeth.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 11:33">Ib. XI, 33</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:4">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>לא תעקר כ׳</he> never have a molar tooth extracted.
<cite ref="Gittin 69a:11">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>לכ׳</he> for pain of the molars.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:2-8">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>שיתין … לכ׳ דקל וכ׳</he> sixty pains befall the teeth of him who hears his neighbor’s sounds (at meals) and is himself not permitted to eat (not being invited).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a:8">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—<he>כ׳ דאקלידא</he>, v. <cite ref="A02918"><he>אַקְלִידָא</he></cite>.—

B. Bath. 167ᵃ כַּכֵּיה דבי״ת Ar., Ms. H. (Ms. M. בבי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note; ed. גַּגֵּיה דבי״ת וכרעיה) the teeth, the upper and the lower horizontal lines of the letter Beth.—[כַּכֵּי cakes, v. כַּעֲכָא.]
